notes.title: The Culinary Hunt Update
notes.content: [p]We’re thrilled to bring you a fresh update full of new hunting opportunities and expanded culinary creativity! notes.title: 🛠️ Update – Quality of Life Improvements (v1.4.4)
notes.content:
We're bringing a fresh wave of comfort and polish to Ale & Tale Tavern! This update focuses on making your experience smoother, clearer, and more enjoyable. Here's what's new:

---

🔍 [b]Helpful Game Hints[/b]  
Now added throughout the game to assist you on your journey.

🗺️ [b]Extra Quest Markers[/b]  
Never miss your next task — new markers make quests easier to follow.

⚗️ [b]Alchemical Lab Reworked[/b]  
Revamped visuals and functionality for smoother potion-making.

⏸️ [b]Pause in Solo Mode[/b]  
Need a break? You can now pause while playing solo.

📜 [b]Food Menu Sorted by Level[/b]  
Recipes are now organized by level for easier browsing.

🧾 [b]Order Desk Redesigned[/b]  
Cleaner and more intuitive — managing orders just got better.

🎯 [b]VIP Orders Stand Out[/b]  
Now you won't miss dishes for VIP customers.

🕷️ [b]Arachnophobia Mode Improved[/b]  
More effective and player-friendly spider-free mode.

💬 [b]Colored Player Chat Names[/b]  
Easier to follow conversations with color-coded names.

🖼️ [b]New Tavern Side-Wall Decor[/b]  
A little extra charm added to your surroundings.

🎛️ [b]Hide UI with a Button[/b]  
Capture clean screenshots or enjoy a minimal interface.

🐛 [b]Bug Fixes & Minor Enhancements[/b]  
Various tweaks under the hood to keep things running smoothly.

---

🎉 [h3]Don't Miss This![/h3]

We’d love to draw your attention to a brand-new release from our wonderful publisher Grab the Games —  
👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2955840/Kitchen_Wars/]Kitchen Wars[/url] launches today!

Play with friends, cook together, compete, and have a blast! 🍳🔥🏆

Check it out and add some delicious chaos to your game night!

notes.title: Helpers Update. These cute owls will help you run the tavern!
notes.content:
[h1]Ale & Tale Tavern: Major Update – Meet the Owl Helpers and More![/h1]

We are excited to announce a major update for [b]Ale & Tale Tavern[/b]! This update brings significant improvements and new features that will drastically enhance your gameplay experience. Let’s dive into what’s new:

---

🦉 [b]Owl Helpers – Automate Your Tavern![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744230/e702b22f4b9a81251a1a8ea7bbc33d716fec057b.gif[/img]

In response to player feedback, we’ve introduced [b]owl helpers[/b] to the game! These cute, intelligent creatures are here to assist with the daily operations of your tavern. Whether it’s cleaning, collecting dirty dishes, taking orders, or serving meals, the owl helpers will automate much of the tavern routine, giving you more time to explore and focus on other activities.

- [b]Cleaner Owl[/b]: Helps with cleaning the tavern and maintaining order.  
- [b]Waiter Owl[/b]: Takes orders and serves food to the customers.

Players can easily activate these helpers by purchasing their respective owl houses from the in-game shop. This feature was highly requested, with over [b]80%[/b] of players asking for automated helpers, particularly for solo players who found the tavern work overwhelming. Now, even solo players can enjoy a more relaxed and engaging gameplay experience!

---

⚔️ [b]Combat System Overhaul[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744230/7a904d09cc6dc9e99af421328ac171ee164a8d8e.gif[/img]

We’ve made major improvements to the [b]combat system[/b], making battles more dynamic and skill-based. Both player abilities and enemy behaviors have been enhanced:

- New player abilities: [b]Block, Dash, and Empowered Attacks[/b].
- [b]Smarter enemies[/b]: Orcs can block and counter-attack, while spiders and other creatures have new attack patterns.  
- [b]Improved enemy agility[/b]: Wolves, boars, and bears are now more challenging, with new jumping and unblockable attacks.  
- [b]Enhanced combat animations[/b]: Animations are smoother and more immersive.  
- [b]Orc rework[/b]: Orcs have received a full animation and visual overhaul, making them look and move better than ever.

These changes make battles more diverse and require strategic thinking, offering a fresh, exciting combat experience.

---

🌿 [b]Additional Features and Improvements[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44744230/825b03a9a5d99f75eb2be455d3226d87ef4cb651.gif[/img]

We’ve also added numerous smaller features and quality-of-life improvements, many of which were directly requested by players. Here are just a few:

[b]Tavern renaming[/b]: Personalize your tavern by giving it a unique name!
[b]New high-level items[/b]: A more powerful broom, hoe, and other tools are now available.
[b]Cheaper respawning[/b]: Reviving is now more affordable.
[b]Bigger bucket capacity[/b]: Carry more with an upgraded bucket.
[b]Improved NPC animations[/b]: NPCs in the tavern now move with more variety, bringing life to your establishment.
[b]Expanded garden beds and second animal pen[/b]: Grow your resources with more farming space.
[b]Light potion[/b]: Carry light while wielding a weapon for better exploration at night.
[b]And much more[/b]!

---

Thank you for your support, and we hope you enjoy the new and improved [b]Ale & Tale Tavern[/b]!

10. Host-client version mismatch prevents connection.
11. Tavern level cap at 20 removed.
12. Item durability further increased.
13. Possible fix for a rare bug with the disappearing boss for some players.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.13
notes.content:

2. Fixed an issue where, after connecting to the host, visitors could appear sitting in mid-air.  
3. Fixed an issue with furniture size and the size potion dependency.  
4. Fixed an issue with Menu Item Showing Different XP in co-op.  
5. Fixed an issue with the durability bar display in the UI.  
6. Fixed an issue with the dual stove where baked bread was being displayed.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.11 - The Big Little Patch
notes.content:
1. Increased the maximum durability of items by 50%. However, items already in your inventory retain their previous durability. All new items purchased or found in the game will have increased durability.
2. Fixed the sound bug with the Pro Grill.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.10
notes.content:
1. Fixed the issue with the cave closing after completing the cave quest. Now, after defeating the Boss, the cave will always remain open.
2. Updated the mug shelf icon to the correct one.
3. Turtles now appear more frequently.
4. Fixed the bug where there were 0 dishes on the Dual Burner Stove.
5. The puddle and hay no longer interact with the tavern’s front door.
6. Improved the interface for multi-step cooking dishes. Some players were unclear that certain dishes needed to be cooked in stages.
7. Fixed the bug where break mess spawns multiple times after loading.
8. Fixed the issue where some visitors appeared without clothes.
9. Corrected a slip in the Deer’s dialogue.
10. Quest items are now forcibly moved into the inventory. This fixes the issue for players who encountered problems with the Herbalist quest. For those who have already faced the problem, the quest items will appear in the inventory 30 seconds after starting the game session.
11. Cloud saves have been implemented.
12. Chickens and pigs no longer run out of the paddock. This was not a bug. These creatures used to escape the pen and run into the tavern if they weren’t fed for a long time. However, many players didn’t understand what was happening. We’ve temporarily removed this feature and will consider how to present it more clearly.
13. Fixed the issue with the sound hanging on the automatic dishwasher.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
Dear Tavern-goers!

Thank you for spending time in the game and sharing your impressions. This is extremely important and helps make the game better!

1. We would like to apologize to some players for an unfortunate bug that we missed — a bug related to autosaves. They were not working correctly. Some players lost their progress, and we are very sorry that this happened. This patch has fixed that issue, and now autosaves work properly.

2. We also fixed the rare bug in the quest with the Herbalist and Mandrake.

3. Additionally, several smaller fixes were made, improving visuals, shadow and light rendering, and more.

PS We are currently working on cloud saves, which will be added to the game as soon as possible. We are also paying attention to your other feedback and taking everything into consideration.

Thank you for being here, dear Tavern-goers!
